post.summary: What resetting this group's offsets would do
post.description: Part of the consumer.offsets.reset flow. This call changes nothing. Resolves the request against the group's live offsets and returns the exact offsets that would be written, any clamping as a warning, and a token valid for five minutes. Changes nothing. Refused on a read-only cluster, so that the wizard never renders a plan that cannot be applied.

post.summary: Write the offsets a plan token names
post.description: Mutation (consumer.offsets.reset). This call changes the cluster and cannot be undone. Takes only a plan token. The group's state and member list are re-checked immediately before the write, because the group may have become active since the plan was made. An expired or tampered token is a validation error, never a silent re-plan.

get.summary: Which build of KUI is running, and what this deployment enables
get.description: Unauthenticated. Contains no URL, hostname or key id: it lists configured service ids only.

get.summary: The caller's identity and the CSRF token to use for mutations
Everything KUI can and cannot do right now
get.description: One entry per configured service. A service that is configured but has not been checked yet appears as degraded with reason STARTING; it is never missing, because 'not asked yet' and 'not deployed' mean different things to whoever is looking.

get.summary: A snapshot, then every capability change as it happens
get.description: The first event is always a full snapshot, so a client that has just connected -- or reconnected -- never has to guess what it missed. There is no cursor and no terminal event: the stream ends when the client disconnects. A heartbeat every fifteen seconds keeps proxies from closing an idle connection.

post.summary: Re-check one service now and return its recomputed state
post.description: What the UI's 'Retry now' button calls. It waits for the check to finish, so the entry it returns is the fresh one rather than the one that was on screen.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: The service id to re-check

get.summary: Every configured cluster, with a status for the list and one for each row
get.description: Always answers 200. The outer section says whether the cluster service could be reached at all - stale means these rows are the last ones that arrived, with the time they did. Each row's own summary says whether that Kafka cluster could be reached. A cluster that is down costs its own row's data and nothing else.

get.summary: Everything the topic page shows, in one document
get.description: Answers 200 whenever the topic exists, however many of its five sections could be filled: a section whose service this deployment does not have is not_configured and is hidden, one whose service could not be reached is unavailable and is shown with its reason. A topic that does not exist is a 404, because that is a different fact from a service that could not answer.

parameters.name: clusterId
parameters.description: The configured cluster's slug id

parameters.name: topicName
parameters.description: The topic's name, as Kafka spells it

get.summary: Browse a topic's records as a stream
get.description: Records arrive as they are read; nothing is buffered into a page first. A record no serde could decode is still delivered, through the fallback serde, with the failure attached to it — a browse never fails because of one unreadable record. Closing the stream closes the Kafka consumer behind it.

parameters.name: clusterId
parameters.description: The configured cluster's slug id

parameters.name: topicName
parameters.description: The topic's name, as Kafka spells it

parameters.name: seekTo
parameters.description: Where to start: 'beginning', 'latest', 'offset::<n>', 'timestamp::<millis>', or one or more '<partition>::<offset>' pairs. The forms do not mix.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: FORWARD or BACKWARD. Absent means whichever the seek implies.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: Which partitions to read. Absent means all of them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to deliver, clamped to the ceiling

parameters.name: isolation
parameters.description: READ_UNCOMMITTED or READ_COMMITTED

parameters.name: keySerde
parameters.description: The serde to read keys with

parameters.name: valueSerde
parameters.description: The serde to read values with

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A plain substring the decoded record must contain

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Tail: start at the end and stay open
